name: XXL Flohmarkt Messe Kassel

rhythm.de: Mehrere Wochenenden im Jahr, samstags und sonntags
rhythm.en: Several weekends a year, Saturday and Sunday

facts: in the halls of Messe Kassel and on the open ground outside
second-hand and antiques, with some new goods
sellers pay from 10 € a metre a day in the hall, from 9 € outdoors with the car at the stall
notes: Opening hours for visitors are nowhere on the organiser's site — it gives only build-up times (Saturday from 07:00, Sunday from 07:00), so 'opening' is left out. Visitor entry fee not stated either. The organiser publishes no e-mail in plain text (the Impressum hides it behind JavaScript); postal address Am Lomberg 1a, 35085 Ebsdorfergrund. Dates from the four per-date pages under Flohmärkte Hessen (article ids 169, 170, 171, 172). No 2027 dates published.

description.de: Mehrere Wochenenden im Jahr in den Hallen der Messe Kassel und auf dem Freigelände davor, samstags und sonntags. Gebrauchtes und Antiquitäten, ein Teil Neuware. Der kleinste Stand misst zwei Meter; draußen kann das Auto am Stand stehen bleiben.
description.en: Several weekends a year in the halls of Messe Kassel and on the open ground outside, Saturday and Sunday. Second-hand and antiques, with some new goods. The smallest stall is two metres; outdoors the car can stay at the pitch.
